The Athole Collection tune index

A searchable index of 919 tunes in James Stewart-Robertson’s The Athole Collection of the Dance Music of Scotland (1884) — strathspeys, reels, jigs, marches and airs, one of the great sources of the Scottish and Cape Breton fiddle repertoire. Open any tune for the book’s own setting with playback.

424 tunes link to their page on thesession.org, where many go by other names — those are shown under the title.
